semantic.justification: Task167 adds the original SharedStringPool owner over actual StringWithHash, OUString and SharedString values. One original-to-uppercase map also owns uppercase-to-uppercase canonical keys; preserve preexisting pointer identities, initial insertion ordering, static empty entry, original two-pass purge and both unit-test counts. std::unordered_map/set value equality binds to native JS exact logical UTF16 string keys, including embedded nul/surrogates and unequal native-hash collisions. Native hash buckets, iterators, mutex and unique_ptr allocation do not become browser libraries; synchronous object operations run to completion and JS GC owns the heap. Purge reads existing SAL value state and drops existing map-owned values; no new counter, WeakRef/finalizer, allocator, lifetime/type registry or memory manager is added. The constructor borrows the source-consumed uppercase operation contract; tests bind task166 actual uppercase to genuine prepared Locale state. This does not fabricate full CharClass, LanguageTag/system locale or UNO service construction. Native allocation failure/concurrency and actual Calc document/sheet/UI/ODS owners remain pending.
